Name: Custom Farm Buildings (non seasonal version)
Author: Billy0815
Description:
Hello,

this mod changes most of the farm buildings.

The buildings are based on the vanilla building with changes according to my taste.
Since I don't like the original coloring of the game I focused on a realistic appearance with realistic colors.

[u][size=5][b]You can get the seasonal version [/b][/size][/u][u][size=5][b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1451/?]here.[/url][/b][/size][/u]


[size=5][u][b]Important:[/b][/u][/size]
This is the non seasonal version of my mod. If you aren't using the mod 'Seasonal Immersion' this one is for you.
Therefore SMAPI is not needed.



[size=4][u][b][size=5]Features:[/size]
[/b][/u][/size][size=2][u]The following buildings are changed:[/u]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Farmhouse including Greenhouse[/size]
[*][size=2]all three Barns[/size]
[*][size=2]all three Coops[/size]
[*][size=2]Shed[/size]
[*][size=2]Stable[/size]
[*][size=2]Silo[/size]
[*][size=2]Slime Hutch[/size]
[*][size=2]Well[/size]
[*][size=2]Mill[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[u]Other files which are changed:[/u]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]craftables (bee house, wood lantern, lightning rod)[/size]
[*][size=2]flooring/springobjects (adjusted paths) [/size]
[/list]
[u][size=2]Optional files:[size=2]
[/size][/size][/u][list]
[*][size=2]Farmhouse -> choose between a decorated and a less decorated farmhouse[/size]
[*][size=2]Well           -> choose between a well and outhouse[/size]
[*][size=2]Outhouse    -> If you want to keep the well and want to use the outhouse as well use this. It replaces the golden clock.[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[b]If you choose the complete pack you'll get all buildings, craftables, floorings and the outhouse in one pack.
I'll upload the files separately so you can choose which ones you want to use.[/b]



[size=5][u][b]Recommended mods:[/b][/u][/size]
[/size]I strongly recommend to use the follwing mods to get an realistic experience similar to the shown screenshots.
[size=2]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/454/?]A less yellow Stardew [/url]and the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/563/?]associated patch[/url][/size]
[/list][size=2][b][color=#ffd966][color=#93c47d][u]Important note: you have to use [/u][/color][color=#93c47d][u]'light dirt and grass 3' version.
[/u]You can use any other map recolor according to your taste but you should definitely use one.[/color]


[/color][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=2][size=3]My [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1411/?]Custom Dark Fence Mod[/url][/size][/size]
[/list][size=2][size=2][b][color=#ffd966][color=#93c47d][u]Important note: you have to install the Fence mod before this mod pack.[/u][/color][/color][/b][/size]
[/size]
[size=4][b][color=#ffd966]It's moreover recommended to use the complete pack.[/color][/b][/size]
[size=2][b][color=#ffd966]

[color=#93c47d][size=5][u]Installation:[/u][/size][/color][color=#93c47d]
Buildings (complete pack): copy the content of the folder 'buildings' to [u][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][b]Stardew Valley/Content/[/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]Buildings.[/u]
Other files: copy craftables.xnb to [size=2][b][u][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][b]Stardew Valley/Content/[/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]TileSheets.
[/u]                   copy[/b][/size] floorings.xnb to [size=2][b][size=2][b][u][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][b]Stardew Valley/Content/[/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]TerrainFeatures.[/u][/b][/size][/b][/size]
                   copy springobjects.xnb to [size=2][b][size=2][b][size=2][b][u][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][b]Stardew Valley/Content/[/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]Maps.[/u][/b][/size][/b][/size][/b][/size]
Optional buildings: copy well.xnb and/or houses.xnb to [size=2][b][color=#ffd966][color=#93c47d][u][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][size=3][size=2][b]Stardew Valley/Content/[/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]Buildings.[/u][/color][/color][/b][/size]



Known issues: the animation of the mill is not the best. I'll try to fix in in a future update.

[color=#ffffff][size=4]If you have any questions, suggestions [b][color=#ffd966][color=#93c47d][color=#ffffff]find errors [/color][/color][/color][/b]feel free to write a comment.[/size][/color][size=4]
I recommend to track this mod because I'll keep it updated.[/size]
[/color][/color][/b][/size]
